spots.name: New Harmony Toll Bridge
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Beall Woods State Park
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Bristol Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 164 m (538 ft).
